items.prompt: Give the number of usable host addresses for 172.24.54.188/20. Enter digits only.
items.explanation: 172.24.54.188/20 belongs to 172.24.48.0/20; broadcast 172.24.63.255; 4094 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: Which IPv4 prefix identifies exactly one destination address in a host route?
items.explanation: A /32 fixes every address bit. A /0 is a default route and /24 describes a larger block.

items.prompt: The active gateway loses its upstream path but its LAN interface remains up. What design consideration matters?
options: Tracking relevant upstream health to influence gateway role
items.explanation: LAN-side liveness alone may not reflect remote reachability. Appropriate tracking can help align the active role with a usable path.

items.prompt: An interface has 12 old CRC errors. Which next observation best distinguishes a current impairment from an old event?
options: Whether CRC errors increase during the test interval
items.explanation: Counter deltas show current behavior. A historical nonzero total alone does not establish an ongoing fault.

items.prompt: A controller accepts a policy request while one target device is offline. What proves completion?
options: Device convergence and intended behavior, not acceptance alone
Only the number of API calls
items.explanation: Acceptance can precede execution. Check deployment status, actual state, and traffic behavior.

items.prompt: Which statement distinguishes a typical remote-access VPN from a site-to-site VPN?
options: Remote access connects an individual client; site-to-site connects networks
Site-to-site VPNs eliminate all endpoint policy
items.explanation: The connection scope differs. Neither model removes the need for authentication, authorization, or endpoint policy.

items.prompt: An ACL has these entries in order: 10 deny ip 192.168.108.0 0.0.0.255 any; 20 permit ip host 192.168.108.6 any; 30 permit ip any any. What happens to a packet sourced by 192.168.108.6? Enter permit or deny.
items.explanation: ACLs stop at the first matching entry. Here the subnet deny matches first.

items.prompt: A client opens TCP from port 51000 to a server on 443. Which port pair normally appears in the server response?
items.explanation: The response reverses the transport endpoints. Ports identify transport conversations rather than physical switch ports.

items.prompt: Why record one controlled change and its observed result before moving to the next?
options: It preserves evidence about cause and recovery
It guarantees no second fault exists
It eliminates the need to retest
items.explanation: Controlled changes make the investigation interpretable. Verification is still needed and multiple faults remain possible.

items.prompt: What does a switch learn from an arriving frame?
items.explanation: MAC learning uses the source address and port within a VLAN.

items.prompt: Installed routes: 10.0.0.0/8 via 192.0.2.231 (AD 1); 10.117.5.80/28 via 192.0.2.8 (AD 110); default via 192.0.2.142. Which next-hop IPv4 address is eligible for 10.117.5.83? Enter only the next-hop address.
items.explanation: The more specific matching installed prefix wins; a lower AD on the less specific route does not override it.

items.prompt: Installed routes: 10.0.0.0/8 via 192.0.2.187 (AD 1); 10.138.5.240/28 via 192.0.2.138 (AD 110); default via 192.0.2.66. Which next-hop IPv4 address is eligible for 10.138.5.245? Enter only the next-hop address.
items.explanation: The more specific matching installed prefix wins; a lower AD on the less specific route does not override it.

items.prompt: What is a useful controlled routing fault?
options: Remove one return route in a saved disposable lab
items.explanation: A single reversible fault supports a clear hypothesis.

items.prompt: Which evidence best verifies a repaired address plan?
options: Recorded host settings and local/remote tests
items.explanation: Configuration and observed reachability support the plan.

items.prompt: What does successful ICMP prove about HTTPS?
options: Only that this ICMP exchange succeeded
items.explanation: Service-specific testing is still required.

items.prompt: Why retain a recovery path during a management ACL change?
options: To recover from an accidental lockout
items.explanation: Management filtering can prevent remote correction.

items.prompt: In {"enabled":true,"vlan":10}, what type is enabled?
items.explanation: Unquoted true is a JSON boolean. "true" would be a string and would not be the same value/type.

items.prompt: Where should the helper for a remote DHCP server normally be applied?
options: The router interface receiving the client broadcasts
items.explanation: Relay begins on the client-facing interface so it can forward the original client broadcast toward the server.

items.prompt: What does a physical link-up indicator prove?
items.explanation: Higher-layer membership and forwarding still require checks.

items.prompt: A broad permit precedes a restrictive deny. What is the concern?
options: The permit may shadow the deny
items.explanation: First-match processing can make later entries unreachable.

items.prompt: Give the network address for 172.19.71.73/28. Enter a dotted IPv4 address.
items.explanation: 172.19.71.73/28 belongs to 172.19.71.64/28; broadcast 172.19.71.79; 14 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: An edge port with BPDU guard receives a BPDU. Which result is consistent with the protection?
options: The port becomes the root bridge
The port can be disabled by the guard
The BPDU is converted to DNS
items.explanation: BPDU guard protects appropriate edge assumptions by reacting to unexpected BPDUs; exact recovery depends on platform configuration.

items.prompt: An ACL selects addresses for NAT. Does this by itself mean nonmatching traffic is denied on the interface?
options: Yes; NAT always replaces firewall policy
Yes; every ACL definition filters every interface
No; NAT selection and interface filtering are separate contexts
items.explanation: The meaning of a match depends on how the ACL is used. A NAT selector is not automatically an applied traffic filter.

items.prompt: 10.4.8.17 matches /8 and 10.4.8.0/24. Which prefix is used?
items.explanation: The /24 is more specific.

items.prompt: Local VLAN 20 works but cross-switch VLAN 20 fails. Which evidence is directly useful?
items.explanation: The inter-switch VLAN path may be missing.

items.prompt: A ping fails after applying an ACL. Which conclusion is justified?
options: More evidence is needed to identify the cause
items.explanation: ICMP failure alone does not identify the failure mechanism.

items.prompt: An overlay tunnel fails because its destination IP cannot be reached. Which dependency should be checked?
items.explanation: An overlay depends on the underlying transport network. Logical policy cannot overcome missing underlay reachability.

items.prompt: Which syslog severity is more urgent: 2 or 6?
options: 2, because lower severity numbers are more urgent
items.explanation: Severity 2 is critical; 6 is informational. The urgency scale runs from 0 emergency to 7 debugging.

items.prompt: Give the broadcast address for 172.27.94.105/27. Enter a dotted IPv4 address.
items.explanation: 172.27.94.105/27 belongs to 172.27.94.96/27; broadcast 172.27.94.127; 30 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: What is the final conventional usable host in 10.8.7.144/28?
items.explanation: The block spans .144–.159. Network and broadcast consume its endpoints, leaving .145–.158 for conventional hosts.

items.prompt: Which is the network for 172.16.31.250/20?
items.explanation: /20 has third-octet increments of 16. Octet 31 belongs to the 16–31 block.

items.prompt: A host moves to another switch port. Why are dynamic learning and aging useful?
options: They assign a new IPv4 subnet
They let forwarding state adapt to changing attachments
items.explanation: Source learning can update the host location, and aging removes unused stale entries. Neither assigns IP addresses.

items.prompt: Why document unused ranges in a summary?
options: The summary can attract traffic to those ranges
items.explanation: A summary covers all addresses in its range.

items.prompt: Which gateway is usable in 10.20.0.64/27?
items.explanation: The usable interval is .65 through .94.

items.prompt: For 192.168.12.70/26, which is an ordinary valid on-link gateway candidate?
items.explanation: The network is .64/26, with usable .65–.126. .1 is outside the subnet and .127 is its broadcast address.

items.prompt: Which representation correctly compresses 2001:0db8:0010:0000:0000:0000:0000:0010?
items.explanation: Only one :: is permitted in an IPv6 address; it represents the required consecutive zero groups.

items.prompt: Which evidence best verifies a repaired address plan?
options: Recorded host settings and local/remote tests
items.explanation: Configuration and observed reachability support the plan.

items.prompt: A client opens TCP from port 51000 to a server on 443. Which port pair normally appears in the server response?
items.explanation: The response reverses the transport endpoints. Ports identify transport conversations rather than physical switch ports.

items.prompt: Give the network address for 172.23.98.105/25. Enter a dotted IPv4 address.
items.explanation: 172.23.98.105/25 belongs to 172.23.98.0/25; broadcast 172.23.98.127; 126 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: Which address is outside the RFC 1918 private ranges?
items.explanation: The private 172 range is 172.16.0.0 through 172.31.255.255. Similar decimal prefixes outside that interval are not private for that reason.

items.prompt: Which proposed /26 network boundary is aligned within 192.168.1.0/24?
items.explanation: /26 blocks start at .0, .64, .128, and .192. An arbitrary host value cannot be used as the network boundary.

items.prompt: A gateway ping succeeds, but a website name does not resolve. Which test best narrows this new symptom?
options: Change the VLAN without checking it
items.explanation: Gateway reachability and name resolution test different functions. Inspect resolver settings and the DNS response.

items.prompt: Give the network address for 172.31.71.142/26. Enter a dotted IPv4 address.
items.explanation: 172.31.71.142/26 belongs to 172.31.71.128/26; broadcast 172.31.71.191; 62 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: Which DNS record type provides an IPv6 address?
items.explanation: AAAA records contain IPv6 addresses; A records contain IPv4 addresses and CNAME supplies an alias.

items.prompt: A switch receives source MAC A and destination MAC B on Fa0/3. Which entry can it learn directly from this arrival?
options: A belongs on Fa0/3 in the receiving VLAN
items.explanation: Learning uses the source address and incoming port. The destination lookup is a separate forwarding step.

items.prompt: Which statement correctly separates reliability from confidentiality?
options: TCP retransmission does not itself encrypt application data
A TCP handshake authenticates the human user
items.explanation: Transport reliability, encryption, and user authentication are different functions. Applications can add protection over either transport model.

items.prompt: Two tenants reuse the same subnet but require independent routing tables on one device. Which mechanism fits?
items.explanation: A VRF creates a separate routing/forwarding context. Any communication between contexts needs an intentional design.

items.prompt: Give the number of usable host addresses for 172.28.149.106/26. Enter digits only.
items.explanation: 172.28.149.106/26 belongs to 172.28.149.64/26; broadcast 172.28.149.127; 62 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: Give the number of usable host addresses for 172.20.91.175/25. Enter digits only.
items.explanation: 172.20.91.175/25 belongs to 172.20.91.128/25; broadcast 172.20.91.255; 126 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: What exactly summarizes adjacent 10.20.0.0/26 and 10.20.0.64/26?
items.explanation: The combined interval is .0 through .127, an aligned /25.

items.prompt: Give the broadcast address for 172.27.19.245/26. Enter a dotted IPv4 address.
items.explanation: 172.27.19.245/26 belongs to 172.27.19.192/26; broadcast 172.27.19.255; 62 ordinary usable host addresses.

items.prompt: Which /28 network is aligned?
items.explanation: /28 blocks start at multiples of 16.

options: The router interface receiving the client broadcasts
items.explanation: Relay begins on the client-facing interface so it can forward the original client broadcast toward the server.
